description: Central registry of all diagram stencil definitions. Registered as a singleton DI service. Multiple IDiagramStencilProvider instances can be registered; when two providers supply the same Id, the definition from the higher-priority provider wins.

members.name: GetAll
members.description: Returns all registered stencils ordered by Category then Name.

members.name: GetCategories
members.description: Returns all distinct category names in display order.

members.name: GetStencil
members.description: Returns the stencil for stencilId, or null if not found.

members.name: GetTempoOriginal
members.description: Returns all registered Tempo-original stencils ordered by set, palette and display order.

members.name: RegisterProvider
members.description: Loads all stencil sets from provider into the registry.

members.name: RegisterStencil
members.description: Registers a single stencil. If a stencil with the same id already exists, the one with higher priority wins (ties keep the existing entry).

members.name: Search
members.description: Searches stencils by name, tags and keywords.
